data.body:
AC amendment: Specify exact .test-index RED marker entries.

For each test function in tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh, add a .test-index entry in the format:
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_dispatcher_routes_to_direct_script]
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script]
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_conflict_data_schema_direct]
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_conflict_data_schema_pr_equivalent]
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy]
  tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_direct_mode_regression_no_network]

Also add source-file mappings:
  plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh

Additional assertion for test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy: assert (a) non-zero exit code, (b) stderr contains BOTH the stored strategy and the current config strategy (not just 'strategy mismatch'), (c) state file is NOT deleted/mutated by the rejection run.

Verify: grep 'test_dispatcher_routes_to_direct_script\|test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script\|merge-to-main.sh:.*test-merge-to-main-dispatcher' .test-index
